description: Keeps the main thread thin: a clearly multi-step / implementation-shaped Bash by the orchestrator (chained >2 steps, a heredoc, sed -i/tee, npm/cargo/make build) warns-then-blocks. A bare >/>> redirect is not implementation on its own. A single unchained read-only one-liner (git status, ls, cat, grep, find) is never blocked, but a chain that merely starts read-only is judged on its full content; subagent commands (agent_id present) are allowed. A `gh ship` RELEASE chain (segment heads all gh-ship/read-only/cd; env-var prefixes ok, never a substring match) is never blocked — the gated merge is the orchestrator's own action (#159). WARN first, BLOCK on repeat within ORCH_THIN_TTL_S (900s). Escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why', or inline `# orchestrator-ok: why` (pre-bash only). on_error=open.
